auth.welcomeBody: Track cash, capture receipts, and stay on top of your numbers — with your accountant a tap away.
auth.emailBody: We'll email you a 6-digit code to log in. No password needed — if you don't have an account yet, ask your accountant to send you an invite.
auth.codeError: That code didn't work. Try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.noAccount: We couldn't find an account for that email. Ask your accountant to send you an invite.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: A history of your receipts and reports.
activity.emptyBody: When you capture receipts and your accountant publishes reports, they’ll show up here.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.subtitle: Photograph a receipt and we’ll read the details for your accountant.
receipts.emptyBody: Your captured receipts will appear here with their status.

tasks.title: Action Center
tasks.subtitle: Review and approve pending items from your accountant.
tasks.couldNotApproveBody: Something went wrong saving your approval. Please try again.
tasks.approvalFallback: Your accountant needs your approval on this item.
tasks.completedNone: No tasks finished this week yet

chat.notLinkedShort: Your account is not linked to a company yet.

gates.stillPending: Still not linked. Try again once your accountant confirms.
gates.suspendedBody: Your accountant has paused access to this workspace — often due to a subscription renewal. Renew now to restore access, or contact your accountant.
gates.noInvoice: No outstanding invoice found — ask your accountant to reactivate your account.

settings.title: Settings
settings.activeSessionsBody: You're signed in on this device. If you've lost a device or just want to be safe, you can sign out everywhere — you'll need to sign in again on all your devices.
settings.languageFailedBody: Your language choice could not be saved on this device. Please try again.

dashboard.editBody: Choose which sections appear on your Home screen.

dashboard.overdueDays_other: Subscription overdue — {{count}} days until access is suspended

backupCodes.title: Backup Codes
backupCodes.intro: Backup codes let you prove it's you if you ever lose access to your email. They are not a second login step — keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
backupCodes.saveNowBody: Each code works once. This is the only time they'll be shown.
backupCodes.setupHint: Generate a set of one-time codes to protect account recovery.
backupCodes.replaceBody: Generating new codes immediately invalidates any codes you already have.
backupCodes.turnOffBody: Your existing codes will stop working.
backupCodes.turnOffFailed: Could not turn off backup codes

billing.title: Billing & Subscriptions
billing.intro: Your accountant's firm subscribes to Mizan on your behalf — this is a read-only view of that plan.
billing.noInfo: No billing information is available for your firm yet.
billing.managedBody: {{feature}} is managed at the firm level by your accountant, not from this app. Ask your accountant if you need this changed.

calendar.timeFormat: Time must be in 24-hour HH:MM format, e.g. 14:30.

capture.photoAccessBody: Enable photo library access in Settings to upload a receipt.
capture.cameraNeededBody: Mizan uses your camera to photograph receipts for your accountant to review.
capture.micBody: Enable microphone access in Settings to record a voice message.
capture.captureFailed: Could not capture the photo. Try again.

companies.title: Management
companies.addBody: Companies are linked to your account by your accountant. Ask them to send an invite to your email — it appears here automatically once you accept.

notificationsScreen.title: Notification Center
notificationsScreen.subtitle: Stay updated with your latest alerts

receiptWizard.introManual: Add the details from your receipt, then tell us what it was for.
receiptWizard.whatForHint: This helps your accountant book it to the right account.
receiptWizard.reviewNote: Your accountant reviews every receipt before anything is recorded in your books.
